headline: Executive order assigns federal agencies duties related to working with faith-based and community groups.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order sets out responsibilities for certain federal agencies regarding faith-based and community organizations. It appears aimed at how these agencies involve such groups in federal programs. No summary was provided, so specific details are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: The order concerns how federal agencies work with these groups, which may affect their involvement in federal programs.
The order gives certain agencies new responsibilities related to faith-based and community initiatives.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed January 29, 2001; executive orders usually take effect when signed.
